raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / UNIQUE PIAZZA CALVI - NUOVA COSTRUZIONE ESCLUSIVA NEL CUORE DI CONEGLIANO NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT UNIQUE Piazza Calvi - Nuova Costruzione Esclusiva nel Cuore di Conegliano CONEGLIANO - CENTRO · CONEGLIANO · TREVISO PRICE Price on request Photos (17) Floor plans (0) 1 / 17 FLOOR AREA 126 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT Yes ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview UNIQUE | The excellence of living in Conegliano In the heart of Conegliano, just steps away from the charm of the historic center and the allure of UNESCO heritage Hills, UNIQUE rises: an avant-garde architectural masterpiece designed for those seeking a perfect balance between contemporary design, privacy, and maximum energy efficiency. The building develops over seven levels, enhanced by an iconic "green" facade and a state-of-the-art eco-sustainable concept aimed at ensuring maximum living comfort in every season. The Residences; Each housing solution is conceived to offer bright spaces, generous sizes, and private outdoor areas, complemented by a practical double garage and relevant cellar. The Garden Residence (Ground Floor): A prestigious apartment of 126 sqm articulated into three bedrooms and three bathrooms that extends outward with a private garden of 150 sqm with independent access — a reserved oasis in the heart of the city. Noble Floors (Floors 1–4): Spacious units (from 135 to 138 sqm) characterized by two or three bedrooms, two bathrooms and splendid outdoor spaces to enjoy all year round among loggias, large terraces, and bioclimatic greenhouses. The Penthouse (Top Floor): A rare beautiful dwelling measuring 253 sqm free on all four sides. It features four bedrooms, three bathrooms embraced by over 70 sqm of terraces and loggias offering panoramic breathtaking views over Castle Conegliano. Rooftops: Atop the complex are three exclusive private relaxation spaces (ranging from 42 to 75 sqm), directly accessible via reserved elevator. Living at UNIQUE means combining independence and tranquility within a high-profile residence with convenience thanks to its strategic location: indeed it is only 220 meters from the train station and 250 meters from Conegliano's historic Duomo.
